overview:
Astute Connect is an India-based expert network that launched in 2020 as a division of Astute Analytica and Report Ocean, market research firms with established data analytics capabilities. Headquartered in New Delhi, the company connects businesses with industry experts for one-on-one consultations and custom recruitment, leveraging its parent company's data analytics expertise to enhance expert matching.

The company claims to serve 500+ global clients across 100+ countries, with AI-powered matching algorithms that analyze client requirements and connect them with the most relevant experts. Astute Connect differentiates through its integration of traditional expert network services with data analytics capabilities inherited from its parent company.

As an organically grown, unfunded company, Astute Connect competes primarily on cost efficiency and regional expertise rather than technology or scale.

history.narrative: Astute Connect emerged from the Astute Analytica ecosystem, a market research and analytics firm based in India. The company was established around 2020 as a natural extension of Astute Analytica's existing research capabilities, adding expert network services to complement its data analytics and market research offerings. The company has grown organically without external funding.
